# ConClear conformance

<!-- Generated by python -m conclear.conformance. Do not edit by hand. -->

ConClear implements the automatable rules of the foundata
[OCI container image build and release guide](https://github.com/foundata/guidelines/blob/0806969483e586dc33a96cf0bf90cc95517b1121/oci-container-image-guide.md)
at revision `0806969483e586dc33a96cf0bf90cc95517b1121`. Every check names the
guide requirements it covers, and the requirement coverage section states a
status for every requirement of that revision.

## Built-in limits

Repository configuration may shorten these limits but cannot extend or disable
them.

|                Limit                 | Maximum |
| ------------------------------------ | ------: |
| Pin resolution freshness             | 24 hours |
| Pin divergence                       |  7 days |
| Candidate lifetime                   |  7 days |
| Fixable HIGH or CRITICAL remediation | 30 days |

## Retired identifiers

No identifiers are retired.

## Requirement coverage

Every requirement of the implemented guide revision has exactly one status.
`automated` means a mechanical check or workflow step enforces it; `manual`
means it needs human judgment, either through a manual check or as described in
the basis; `external` means a control outside ConClear's scope owns it;
`unsupported` means the guide permits a choice this release does not implement.
A requirement that a manual check covers is manual even when automated checks
support it. The basis names the checks that cover a requirement or explains its
status.

|   Status    | Requirements |
| ----------- | -----------: |
| automated   |          248 |
| manual      |          143 |
| external    |           24 |
| unsupported |            7 |
